name: alma-image-generation
description: Use when the owner asks to create one or more new standalone images, posters, illustrations, or visual variations. It stages the existing generate_image approval card; generation starts only after approval and the finished image returns to the same chat.
whenNotToUse: An existing image that only needs inspection or conversion is not generation. Product-faithful imagery needs a real product reference first. Charts and live dashboards are structured UI, not generated pictures.
stopConditions: Never claim an image was generated before the worker result is present in the conversation
Never replace the approval card with a prose-only permission question
Never use incident-diagnosis, health-scan, or browser tools for a standalone image request
